name: Openship Webmail
description: A fast, self-hosted webmail client. Point it at any IMAP/SMTP mailbox — an Openship Mail server, Gmail, Fastmail, or your company's — and read, search and send from a clean UI on your own domain. Nothing is stored outside your server.

configFields.label: Session encryption key
configFields.help: Auto-generated (32 random bytes, hex). Encrypts each signed-in user's IMAP password at rest. Changing it signs everyone out; they just sign in again.

configFields.label: Branding admin token
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Lets Openship write this webmail's white-label login page (logo, name, colors) over its admin API. Nothing else accepts it.

settings.label: Mail backend
settings.description: Which IMAP/SMTP server this webmail talks to. Leave the hosts blank and each address resolves to mail.<its own domain> at sign-in — the convention Openship Mail and iRedMail install. Set them to pin every mailbox to one server. Users can still override host and port on the sign-in screen.

fields.label: IMAP host
fields.help: Where mail is read from. Blank → mail.<domain of the address signing in>.

fields.label: SMTP host
fields.help: Where mail is sent through. Blank → mail.<domain of the address signing in>.

fields.label: SMTP port
fields.help: Blank → 587 (submission, STARTTLS). Use 465 for implicit TLS — the port alone selects the mode, and TLS is required either way.

settings.label: Access
settings.description: Where this webmail is reached from. Filled in from the hostname you route it on — override it only when something in front of it changes the origin the browser sees.

fields.label: Trusted origins
fields.help: Comma-separated origins allowed to sign in — scheme + host, no path. Defaults to this app's own public URL. Set it when the app is served through a proxy Openship doesn't route, e.g. an Openship Mail server fronting mail.<domain> for a cloud deploy.

settings.label: AI assistance
settings.description: Optional MiniMax configuration for email composition and subject generation.

fields.label: MiniMax API key
fields.help: Bearer token used only by the webmail server for AI generation requests.

connection.title: Sign in to Webmail
connection.description: Open the webmail URL and sign in with a full email address and its mailbox password. There is no separate account to create — the mailbox on your IMAP server is the account.

guide.intro: Your project runs its own webmail client. It holds no mail: every message is read live from IMAP, and only encrypted session credentials and per-user settings live on disk.
guide.useHint: Webmail is domain-only by design: sessions use Secure cookies, so sign-in never completes over plain http, and the container publishes nothing to the host — the edge reaches it on loopback. Point a hostname at it and TLS is issued automatically.

outputs.label: Webmail
outputs.help: Sign in with an email address on your mail server and its mailbox password.
